verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly list 'regional endpoints' alongside BYOC and self-hosting as deployment options for data residency, and self-hosting/BYOC pages confirm customers can keep infrastructure and data under their own control. However, this is framed as an enterprise-tier feature with no specifics on which regions are supported, no self-serve UI for selecting a region, and no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: concrete list of available regions/residency options, self-serve region selection mechanism, and third-party verification.
